test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 17 May, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate option to substitute the bracketed segment in the given sentence. If there is no need to substitute it, select 'no substitution required'.**

Some of them were nearly (as hard as ligament, and many an inch in length).

options.text: as hard as ligaments, and many were an inch long
hard as ligament, and many an inch at length
as hard as a ligament, and many an inches in length

solution:
The correct answer is** "as hard as ligaments, and many were an inch long."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The original sentence uses** "ligament" **in singular form, which is incorrect as **"ligament"** is a countable noun and should be pluralized.
 
• The correct comparison is **"as hard as ligaments"** instead of **"as hard as ligament."**
 
• The correct description of length is **"an inch long"** instead of **"many an inch in length." **
 
• The correct answer is Option 1.

 

**Correct sentence**: *Some of them were nearly **as hard as ligaments, and many were an inch long**__.*
